name: The Scythe of Elune
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.details:
Your story rings true... I do not entirely understand your motives, but if your business here in Duskwood involves ridding the forest of worgen in any number, then I can forgo understanding for results.

There is a mine to the south that has been overrun with worgen... They appeared out of nowhere, but from what we know, that is where they first were found.

Go about your business, but I would ask that if you find anything of import, you share it with me. We will accept any aid in our war against evil.
narrative.objectives: Look for signs of the Scythe of Elune then return to Jonathan Carevin in Darkshire.
narrative.offerRewardText:
It is an interesting story you tell, adventurer. Though the Carevin family's influence is not large enough that we might find the root of these troubles and finish them once and for all, we will do what we can to contain the worgens' numbers in Duskwood.

Already I have instructed Calor to make this his first priority.
narrative.requestItemsText: The woods are perilous for the unprepared. Keep your weapons close at hand and your wits even closer, or your next journey into the haunted forest may be your last.
objectiveText: Find evidence of the Scythe of Elune

chain.subtitle: 9 quests at level 30, 12,400 XP in all.

quests.name: The Howling Vale
quests.objectiveText: Go to the Howling Vale and study the Tome of Mel'Thandris, then return to Sentinel Melyria Frostshadow at Forest Song.

quests.name: Velinde Starsong
quests.objectiveText: Speak with Thyn'tel Bladeweaver at the Warrior's Terrace in Darnassus.

quests.name: Velinde's Effects
quests.objectiveText: Search through Velinde's chest for her journal, then return it along with the key to Thyn'tel Bladeweaver in Darnassus.

quests.name: The Barrens Port
quests.objectiveText: Speak with Wharfmaster Dizzywig in Ratchet.

quests.name: Passage to Booty Bay
quests.objectiveText: Take a boat to Booty Bay and speak with Caravaneer Ruzzgot.

quests.name: The Caravan Road
quests.objectiveText: Speak with Clerk Daltry in Darkshire.

quests.name: The Carevin Family
quests.objectiveText: Speak with Jonathan Carevin in Darkshire.

quests.name: The Scythe of Elune
quests.objectiveText: Look for signs of the Scythe of Elune then return to Jonathan Carevin in Darkshire.

quests.name: Answered Questions
quests.objectiveText: Return to Thyn'tel Bladeweaver in Darnassus.
